settings.scope: Independent source reconstruction on every recorded state and 2/4 Gauss nodes, with local/global heat, work and entropy accounting. Recorded reactive species/element/source comparisons; dense values use independent source equilibrium. Union-node time comparison and adiabatic endpoint. No continuous-time error bound.

adiabatic_equilibrium.method: Independent simultaneous constant U+pV and mechanical equilibrium, not a second time integrator.
